newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu to return to Zaire Friday, ducks photo call.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to return to Zaire Friday, ducks photo call.

text.p: Ailing Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko will return to Kinshasa on Friday to seek a political solution to his country's deepening crisis, his son and spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.

The 66-year-old president, released from a Monaco hospital on Wednesday after further cancer treatment, failed to appear at a planned photo session. His son, Mobutu Nzanga, said his schedule was too busy.

"He is going to the capital tomorrow. His intention is to find a solution to the present crisis in consultation with parliament, the government and the military high command," Mobutu Nzanga told Reuters.

The spokesman declined comment on an attempt by the transitional Zairean parliament to fire Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo, saying the president would discuss it with the country's political institutions.

Mobutu, facing a spreading revolt in eastern Zaire against his 32-year rule, summoned photographers to his villa on Thursday in what appeared to be an attempt to quell reports he was seriously ill following prostate cancer surgery last August.

But at the last minute, journalists were told the president would not, after all, be appearing. "He has a very busy schedule today so it will be very difficult to have a photo session this morning," Mobutu Nzanga said.
